title: Nigeria Payments, Recovery Stability, and Toast UX Cleanup

highlight.title: Monnify Rollout for Nigeria
highlight.description: Added Monnify-powered Nigeria verification and .cid payment flows, plus admin-managed pricing and smoother KYC payment return handling.

summary: This update strengthens both account recovery and Nigeria payment flows while cleaning up several rough edges across profile and review management. Recovery now keeps users on a valid OTP session instead of rejecting fresh codes against stale screens, review owners can actively manage invitations instead of only archiving approved feedback, Monnify now powers Nigeria-specific verification and .cid checkout flows, and frontend browser alerts have been replaced with the reusable toast system for a more consistent product experience.

categories.title: Recovery Flow Reliability
items: Kept the Recover account button active in onboarding and hosted auth, but now require a valid email before recovery can continue.
Reused a single active recovery OTP verification session per user instead of leaving multiple pending recovery sessions alive.
Prevented the common failure mode where a fresh recovery email code looked incorrect because the user was still on an older verification screen.
Added inline recovery guidance instead of leaving the CTA looking inactive or broken.

categories.title: Reviews & Public Profile UX
items: Expanded owner-side review management to support resend invite, generate fresh link, revoke request, archive, and status filtering.
Exposed invite status metadata such as expiry, lockout, and last access to owners managing endorsement requests.
Added a profile reviews drawer overlay so public profiles can preview reviews without forcing an immediate page navigation.
Kept the dedicated full reviews page as the canonical long-form destination.

categories.title: Nigeria Payment Infrastructure
items: Extended the Monnify service to support checkout initialization, transaction status queries, and webhook signature handling.
Added Monnify payment creation for Nigeria Layer 3 verification and Monnify NGN checkout for .cid registration.
Restricted Monnify .cid checkout visibility to Nigeria users and presented it as a local Pay in Naira option.
Enforced completed Monnify payment before NIN or BVN verification can call the provider-backed identity checks.
Improved the Monnify KYC return path so verification details are restored, payment confirmation is polled briefly, and the flow resumes automatically on return.

categories.title: Admin Payment Controls
items: Added persisted admin payment settings for Nigeria verification fee and USD-to-NGN conversion rate.
Made Monnify runtime pricing prefer admin-managed values while preserving environment defaults as fallback.
Added an admin dashboard panel for Monnify payment settings instead of requiring every pricing adjustment to go through deployment secrets.

categories.title: Frontend UX Cleanup
items: Mounted the reusable toast system globally and added shared notification helpers for success, info, warning, and error states.
Removed browser alert() usage across onboarding, KYC, admin, settings, profile editing, copy actions, integrations, and landing workflows.
Replaced blocking popup notifications with the shared toast experience for a more consistent product feel.
Corrected the public profile verification hero so unverified profiles no longer display verified-only copy.

title: Layer 3 Duplicate Identity Enforcement

highlight.title: Cross-Account Duplicate Blocking
highlight.description: Layer 3 now rejects reused NIN, BVN, ID number, and phone number across different accounts.

summary: This update closes a fraud gap in the normal Layer 3 review flow by enforcing direct off-chain duplicate checks before identity data is saved. NIN verification, BVN verification, and final document submission now reject reused identity records across different accounts with a clear API error instead of relying on manual review to catch duplicates.

categories.title: Duplicate Identity Protection
items: Added shared Layer 3 duplicate checks for NIN, BVN, document number, and phone number across other user accounts.
NIN verification now returns a 409 conflict when the same NIN already exists on another Layer 3 request.
BVN verification now returns a 409 conflict when the same BVN already exists on another Layer 3 request.
Final Layer 3 submission now blocks reused document numbers and phone numbers before the request enters admin review.
Duplicate checks normalize values before comparison so spacing, casing, and phone formatting do not bypass enforcement.

categories.title: Verification Architecture Notes
items: Implemented duplicate enforcement off-chain to avoid introducing additional chain gas costs for identity uniqueness checks.
Kept biometric nullifier protection scoped to the separate ZK flow rather than coupling it to the standard Layer 3 review flow.
Left identity_data_hash as optional future privacy infrastructure instead of making it a requirement for duplicate blocking.

title: Authoritative CNS Fulfillment & Contextual Alias Routing

highlight.title: Contextuals Lifecycle Repair
highlight.description: Root-name payments now finalize server-side, and contextual subdomains consistently resolve from the user-owned alias.

summary: This update closes the most fragile gaps in the .cid and contextual identity lifecycle. Premium name payments are now fulfilled authoritatively on the server instead of depending on a browser polling loop, the fiat checkout route and plan mapping are aligned across frontend and backend, and contextual identities now consistently treat alias as the owned hostname prefix. We also added local custom host support for contextual testing and isolated the ZK prover entry so the liveness proof path can lazy-load independently from the main frontend flow.

categories.title: Premium Name Fulfillment
items: Moved premium .cid registration fulfillment into a shared server-side payment finalization path instead of relying on /cns-success polling to mint names.
RevenueCat and Boomfi webhooks now attempt authoritative post-payment registration immediately after marking the payment complete.
GET /api/payment/status/:reference now acts as a status check and retry path rather than the primary mint trigger.
Fixed fiat checkout initialization to call the mounted /api/payment/revenuecat/create route.
Payment creation now binds authenticated user identity to each checkout instead of using guest fallback metadata.

categories.title: Plan & Registration Integrity
items: Centralized premium .cid pricing, duration, and RevenueCat package mapping in shared CNS plan configuration used by both frontend and backend.
Aligned supported plans to 1 year, 3 years, and lifetime across checkout UI and payment processing.
Locked direct POST /api/cns/register behind a completed payment reference so premium names cannot bypass payment enforcement.
Preserved coupon-based 100% claims while keeping premium root registration on the same resolver sync path.

categories.title: Contextual Alias Model
items: Standardized contextual ownership so alias is always the subdomain prefix, while context remains the category (professional, gaming, social, etc.).
Updated my-names, CNS routing, resolver logic, and public profile lookup to resolve pay.alice.cid from alias instead of leaking category names into hostnames.
Migrated legacy /api/cns/subname creation to write the same alias/context schema used by Context DID creation.
Updated subdomain rebinding to modify alias instead of overwriting context category fields.
Unified contextual full-name generation through shared server helpers to prevent drift between root-name fallback paths.

categories.title: Local Routing & Testing
items: Added frontend contextual host parsing for custom local domains like name.casperid.cid.
Added localhost-style contextual detection for hosts such as name.localhost and name.casperid.localhost.
Kept ?subdomain=name override support for manual local testing while expanding true host-based contextual routing.

categories.title: ZK Runtime Isolation
items: Removed the circomlibjs Poseidon browser import from the nullifier path to stop that hashing helper from inflating the main frontend bundle.
Lazy-loaded zkProver from LivenessCheck only when proof generation starts, producing a dedicated small prover entry chunk instead of statically linking the module into the liveness component bundle.
Confirmed the remaining oversized proof chunk is primarily the Noir/Barretenberg browser proving runtime, not the old browser-side Poseidon helper.

title: Hosted Authorization & Lightweight SDK v2

highlight.title: Hosted Authorization Launch
highlight.description: Moved all authentication, onboarding, passkey, and verification to account.casperid.com/authorize with a lightweight OAuth/PKCE SDK.

summary: This major release relocates all authentication, onboarding, and verification flows to a centralized hosted authorization endpoint at account.casperid.com/authorize. The React SDK v2 has been rebuilt as a lightweight OAuth/PKCE client — removing the embedded CasperIDModal and all heavy browser verification dependencies. Backend authorization enforcement is now authoritative, with provisional L3 access support for users with pending KYC. The SDK v2 public API consists of authorizeWithCasperID, useHostedAuthorizationCallback, and a CasperIDButton component supporting popup and redirect transport modes.

categories.title: Secure OAuth Backend
items: Extended GET /api/oauth/authorize/validate to return app name, logo, required_tier, requested_scopes, and redirect URI validation.
Updated POST /api/oauth/authorize/complete to enforce the app's required tier against the authenticated user's actual tier.
Require valid authenticated CasperID session and completed L1 onboarding before authorization code issuance.
Bound snapshot to each authorization code: granted tier, required tier, scopes, authorization status, verification status.
Reject direct authorization attempts when user does not satisfy the required tier.

categories.title: L3 Pending Contract
items: Approved L3 users receive normal authorization results with authorization_status: complete.
Users with genuine pending L3 request and at least L2 receive provisional 24-hour business tokens.
Provisional tokens include tier, required_tier, authorization_status: provisional, verification_status: pending, and scopes.
Users without a pending L3 request cannot receive provisional L3 access.

categories.title: Hosted Account Flow
items: Refactored HostedAuthorize.tsx as the controller for the full hosted authorization journey.
Extracted reusable account-side workflows: signup/OTP, passkey/L1 onboarding, L2 liveness, L3 document verification.
Adapted onboarding so failures prevent authorization with retryable errors.
Adapted KYC workflows to expose terminal results: completed, pending, cancelled, failed.
Display consent using the app's actual requested scopes; denial returns OAuth access_denied with original state.
Support both popup layouts and full-page mobile redirect layouts.

categories.title: Lightweight React SDK v2
items: Published SDK v2 as a lightweight OAuth/PKCE client with public API: authorizeWithCasperID(), consumeHostedAuthorizationCallback(), useHostedAuthorizationCallback(), CasperIDButton.
CasperIDButton supports auto, popup, and redirect transport modes.
Removed CasperIDModal, embedded signup/KYC screens, modal-only APIs, and heavy browser verification dependencies.
Callback consumption is idempotent under React Strict Mode with origin, state, and PKCE transaction validation.
Popup closure treated as cancellation only after confirming no valid callback was received.

categories.title: Casperdrop Reference Integration
items: Upgraded Casperdrop to SDK v2 using CasperIDButton for authorization start.
Maintained /auth/callback as the registered redirect URI.
Displays actual authorization state: complete, provisional L3 pending, denied, cancelled, failed.
Successful authorization closes popup and updates main Casperdrop page.

title: Brevo SMTP Migration & Email Provider Fix

highlight.title: Brevo Email Provider Migration
highlight.description: Migrated from custom SMTP (mail.ile.africa) to Brevo for reliable transactional email delivery.

summary: This update migrates the SMTP email provider to Brevo for improved deliverability and maintainability. Fixed an issue where the email sender address was using the SMTP login instead of the configured EMAIL_FROM, ensuring all emails now correctly send from no-reply@casperid.com. All 7 email types (OTP, welcome, verification, profile views, payments, security alerts) tested and verified.

categories.title: Email Provider Migration
items: Migrated SMTP provider from mail.ile.africa to Brevo (smtp-relay.brevo.com) for production-ready email delivery.
All 7 email types (OTP, welcome, verification success, profile viewed, profile completed, payment confirmation, security alert) verified via Brevo SMTP.
OTP emails now reliably sent through Brevo SMTP with full delivery confirmation.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Fixed email sender address: All email methods now use EMAIL_FROM env var instead of SMTP_USER, ensuring emails send from the correct sender (no-reply@casperid.com).
Updated SmtpProvider default fallback to no-reply@casperid.com for consistency.
Applied fix across all 7 email methods: welcome, verification, profile viewed, profile completed, payment confirmation, security alert, and OTP.

title: Android Passkey Support & Multi-Tenant Architecture

highlight.title: Native Android Passkey Integration
highlight.description: Launched Android Digital Asset Links with per-app configuration, enabling seamless passkey authentication for React Native and native Android apps.

summary: This milestone release introduces comprehensive Android passkey support through Digital Asset Links, transforming CasperID into a truly multi-tenant platform where each business configures their own Android apps. We've also fixed critical documentation gaps around Origin header validation and expanded our documentation with complete React Native integration guides.

categories.title: Android Digital Asset Links
items: Multi-Tenant Android Configuration: Each business app can now configure multiple Android packages with SHA256 fingerprints through the dashboard.
Dynamic Asset Links Endpoint: /.well-known/assetlinks.json now aggregates all active business apps' Android configurations from the database.
Business Dashboard UI: Added 'Android Configuration' section to Integration Detail page with add/remove functionality and helpful keytool commands.
Per-App Package Management: Businesses can configure debug and release certificate fingerprints independently for seamless development-to-production workflows.
Real-Time Validation: Android apps are instantly authorized for passkey operations after configuration saves.

categories.title: Backend Architecture Updates
items: Database Schema: Added android_digital_assets array to BusinessApp model with package_name and sha256_fingerprints fields.
API Enhancement: PATCH /api/business/apps/:app_id now handles android_digital_assets with validation and sanitization.
Origin Validation: Passkey finish endpoints now validate Origin header against BusinessApp.allowed_origins for security.
Aggregation Logic: Public assetlinks.json endpoint queries active apps and deduplicates package names automatically.
Removed Hardcoding: Eliminated all hardcoded environment variables for Android configuration in favor of database-driven multi-tenancy.

categories.title: Documentation Overhaul
items: React Native Integration Guide: Complete 6-step guide covering OTP auth, passkey registration, and authentication for mobile apps.
Android Setup Documentation: Step-by-step guide with keytool commands, dashboard configuration, and Google validation tools.
Origin Header Requirement: Added critical missing documentation for Origin header validation in passkey finish endpoints.
Common Mistakes Section: Documented trailing slashes, protocol mismatches, and port number issues that cause verification failures.
Mobile Integration Category: New documentation section in Business Docs with nested Android Setup guide.
Code Examples Updated: All passkey examples now include proper Origin header and reference dashboard configuration.

categories.title: Security & Validation
items: SHA256 Fingerprint Normalization: Backend automatically uppercases and trims certificate fingerprints for consistency.
Package Name Validation: Filters empty package names and validates format before saving to database.
Origin Whitelist Enforcement: WebAuthn verification now strictly validates Origin header against allowed_origins per business app.
1-Hour Cache TTL: Asset links endpoint uses shorter cache duration (1hr vs 24hr) for faster configuration updates.
Cross-Origin Security: Extended existing CORS logic to support passkey operations across business apps' allowed origins.

categories.title: User Experience Improvements
items: Interactive Modal: Beautiful modal UI for adding Android apps with package name and fingerprint inputs.
Inline Commands: Keytool commands displayed directly in the add modal for easy copy-paste.
Visual Feedback: Shows fingerprint count and displays each fingerprint in monospace font for easy verification.
Delete Protection: One-click removal of Android packages with visual confirmation.
Help Text: Context-aware descriptions explaining Digital Asset Links and their importance for passkey support.

title: Layer 3 Verification & SDK Theme Fixes

highlight.title: Complete Layer 3 Verification Overhaul
highlight.description: Fixed critical data submission issues and reimagined AI's role in admin review workflows.

summary: This release resolves critical issues where Layer 3 verification data wasn't appearing in the admin dashboard, reimagines the AI verification workflow to support human-in-the-loop approval, and fixes SDK light mode visibility across all screens. The result is a robust, production-ready Layer 3 KYC flow.

categories.title: Layer 3 Verification Fixes
items: Fixed Liveness Frame Storage: Liveness check frames now upload to ImageKit and display in admin dashboard for review.
Fixed Document Image Persistence: Front/back document images now properly saved and visible to admins.
Fixed Personal Data Submission: Names, DOB, nationality, and all document fields now correctly stored in verification_data.
Enhanced Admin Data Mapping: V2 verification requests now properly flatten nested data for admin UI compatibility.
Added Metadata Compatibility Layer: Created metadata object bridge for frontend expectations (liveness_frames, document details).

categories.title: AI Verification Logic Redesign
items: Layer 3 AI-Assisted Review: AI now provides analysis for admin review instead of making final decisions.
Auto-Accept for Admin Queue: Layer 3 submissions always proceed to admin review regardless of AI score.
AI Metadata Tracking: Stores AI decision (passed/failed), confidence score, and reasoning separately for admin visibility.
Layer 2 Auto-Approval: Maintained AI as final decision-maker for Layer 2 liveness-only verification.
Admin UI Enhancement: Added AI analysis panel showing decision, confidence, and reasoning in request details.

categories.title: SDK Light Mode & Theme Fixes
items: Fixed Light Mode Visibility: Replaced all hardcoded dark/light colors with theme-aware CSS variables.
Universal Theme Support: All 14 SDK screens now properly adapt between light and dark modes.
Improved Contrast: Text, borders, backgrounds, and placeholders now visible in both themes.
Consistent Design System: Migrated to text-main, text-muted, bg-brand-5, bg-brand-10 utility classes.
Glass Container Polish: Unified glass-container class for consistent backdrop effects across themes.

categories.title: Technical Improvements
items: Data Preservation: /layer3/submit now preserves existing liveness data when document data is added.
ImageKit Parallel Uploads: Optimized liveness frame uploads with Promise.all for better performance.
Error Handling: Added graceful fallbacks for ImageKit upload failures (verification proceeds without frames).
Removed Debug Logging: Cleaned up verbose console.log statements while preserving critical error logs.
Request Validation: Enhanced logging for troubleshooting verification request lifecycle.

summary: This update introduces a comprehensive onboarding experience designed to guide users through the CasperID ecosystem. From an interactive dashboard tour to a gamified quest system that rewards identity milestones, we've made it easier than ever to get verified and started.

categories.title: Onboarding & Gamification
items: Interactive Platform Tour: Step-by-step walkthrough of core identity management features.
Quest System: Integrated gamified milestones (QuestModal, QuestCard) to track and reward onboarding progress.
Welcome UI: New interactive cards to simplify the transition from guest to verified user.

categories.title: SDK & Developer Experience
items: CSRF Security Fix: Exempted /api/auth routes from CSRF checks to support cross-origin SDK requests.
Origin Parsing Guard: Hardened Business Dashboard to automatically parse comma-separated origin lists.
Device-Aware UI: Fixed SDK extension button visibility logic to prioritize mobile vs desktop detection.

categories.title: Ecosystem Expansion
items: Events Landing Page: A massive new section dedicated to ecosystem events and community updates.
Quick Actions Rail: Enhanced dashboard navigation for faster access to identity tools.

title: SDK Global Launch & Business Ecosystem

highlight.description: Launched multi-language SDK support and the Live Business Integrations Directory.

summary: This milestone marks the official global launch of our SDK and the expansion of the CasperID Business Ecosystem. Users can now verify across 4 languages, while businesses gain deep visibility through the new Integrations Directory and Activity Heatmap.

categories.title: SDK & User Experience
items: Global Localization: Full multi-language support for English, Spanish, French, and German.
Flexible Layout Modes: Added Auto, Modal, and Fullscreen integration modes for dApps.
Passkey-First Onboarding: Streamlined verification-to-auth flow for a seamless user journey.
Selective Disclosure Audit: Verified functional integrity of Context DIDs and privacy shares.

categories.title: Business Platform
items: Live Integrations Directory: A centralized hub for discovering and navigating verified CasperID dApps.
Activity Heatmap: Real-time visualization of verification trends aggregated from webhook logs.
App Branding: Support for website URLs and public discovery settings in the business portal.
Business API: New public directory endpoint (GET /api/business/public/apps).

categories.title: Security & Protocol
items: MetaMask Support: Integrated ECDSA (EIP-191) signature verification for multi-chain account linking.
Cryptographic Hardening: Transitioned to production-grade Ed25519 digital signatures for ZK proofs.
Protocol Roadmap: Added Phase 5 research for Self-Sovereign Recovery (SSR) mechanisms.

title: National ID Verification & OCR Robustness

highlight.title: Robust National ID Flow
highlight.description: Hardened OCR processing for ID cards and implemented a fallback flow.

summary: This update fixes critical issues with National ID image submission. We've optimized the OCR pipeline to upload images first, ensuring admins can view documents even if automatic parsing fails. We've also normalized document types across the stack.

categories.title: Fixes & Improvements
items: National ID OCR: Optimized flow to upload images to ImageKit before OCR, ensuring visibility for admins.
Document Type Normalization: Supported both 'license' and 'drivers_license' IDs to prevent schema mismatches.
Image Submission: Fixed bug where National ID images weren't correctly linked to verification requests.
OCR Fallback: Added 'Review & Edit' step if OCR confidence is low or parsing fails.
Backend Validation: Enhanced document upload routes with stricter field requirements and success structures.

title: Premium CNS & Wildcard Identity Routing

highlight.title: Human-First Subdomains
highlight.description: Launched wildcard identity routing: every user now owns their piece of the web at [name].casperid.com with instant SSL.

summary: This milestone update introduces the full implementation of Premium .cid names on the Casper Network and the deployment of our Hybrid Privacy Infrastructure. We've integrated Noir-based ZK circuits with Starknet to enable anonymous biometric nullifiers, alongside a Smart Subdomain Gateway for native vanity URLs.

categories.title: New Features
items: CasperID ZK 2.0: Launched the 'Privacy Bridge' using Noir ZK Circuits for anonymous biometric verification.
Starknet Proof Verification: Integrated on-chain logging of anonymous 'Nullifiers' to prevent Sybil attacks without doxxing users.
Wildcard Subdomain Support: Profiles now resolve directly from vanity URLs (e.g. alice.casperid.com).
Multi-Chain Payment Rails: Integrated Boomfi and RevenueCat for crypto/fiat name registrations.
Casper CNS Protocol: On-chain name registration and NFT minting for premium identity markers.
Social Viral Flow: New success screen with 'Brag on X' and direct 'View Profile' integration.

categories.title: Fixes & Syncing
items: Hybrid Attestation Model: Updated Noir circuit to verify server-side face-matching signatures for enhanced security.
Unified Identity Sync: Premium names now automatically replace legacy human IDs in profiles and credentials.
JWT Metadata Enhancement: CNS names are now embedded in auth tokens for zero-latency UI updates.

title: Analytics Integration & UX Refinement

highlight.title: Integrated Behavioral Analytics
highlight.description: Deployed Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, and Google Tag Manager to gain deep insights into user identity verification hurdles.

summary: This update focuses on infrastructure for user behavior analysis and refining the Trust Score logic for improved accuracy. We've also hardened analytics reliability by optimizing script load order and improved mobile responsiveness across the roadmap and profile views.

categories.title: New Features
items: Integrated Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, and Google Tag Manager for comprehensive behavioral analytics.
Implemented optimized analytics load-order: moved high-priority tracking scripts to the top of the <head> for maximum data reliability.

categories.title: Fixes & Improvements
items: Refined Trust Score calculation logic to ensure real-time accuracy across complex profile states.
Enhanced Roadmap Contrast: Improved legibility of detail panels against dark backgrounds for better accessibility.
Optimized Profile Responsiveness: Fixed layout shifts on mobile viewports for public identity pages.
Aligned mail sender configurations for consistent system notification delivery.

title: Global Trust Score & Application Guard

highlight.title: Profile Score Required to Apply
highlight.description: Introduced a unified 0–100 Trust Score combining identity verification tier and profile completeness. Users must score 60+ to submit job applications.

summary: This release introduces a Global Trust Score that merges identity verification (Layer 1/2/3) with profile completeness (experience, education, skills, certifications, projects, awards, languages, social links, and more). The Apply button on job listings now displays the applicant's live score, and a Profile Completion Modal guides low-scoring users to improve their profile or verify their identity before applying.

categories.title: New Features
items: Global Trust Score engine: a unified 0–100 score combining Identity Tier (50 pts) and Profile Completeness (50 pts) with no additional API calls.
Application Guard: Apply button on job listings shows the user's live score badge and blocks submissions below 60 points.
Profile Completion Modal: surfaces when score is below threshold, showing a progress bar, threshold marker, top improvement tips, and CTAs to complete profile or verify identity.
CTAs in modal navigate directly to /dashboard?view=profile and /dashboard?view=kyc for a frictionless fix flow.
Dashboard Trust Score card updated to reflect the new unified score instead of the previous identity-tier-only estimate.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Vite deprecation warning: updated import.meta.glob from deprecated `as: 'raw'` to `query: '?raw', import: 'default'` syntax.
Fixed navigation from Profile Completion Modal using window.location.href instead of React Router navigate to correctly trigger the app's view-sync on query string changes.

items: Standardized Persona URLs: Transitioned context profiles to subdomain-based paths (e.g., /did/game.bika).
Public Profile Responsiveness: Optimized header and card layouts for mobile and tablet viewports.
Credential Vault UX: Updated identity sharing logic to generate human-readable URLs by default.

AI Liveness Stability: Implemented robust JSON parsing for Gemini responses to handle markdown code fences.
Aligned Profile Identifiers: Corrected DID labels in profile views to show identity aliases instead of pending status.
Synchronized Data Schemas: Aligned frontend disclosure keys with backend database models for accurate field display.
